_comment_AllowedHosts: setup-vps.sh replaces YOUR_DOMAIN. Caddy forwards the original Host header, so the domain must be allowed here or every request gets HTTP 400.
_comment_Urls: Kestrel listens on loopback only — Caddy (HTTPS) is the sole public entry point.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Postgres runs on the same VPS. The real password is injected via the E6_DB_PASSWORD environment variable (see /etc/e6carspa/api.env); SET_IN_ENV is replaced at startup.

Jwt._comment_Key: Deliberately left as a placeholder: the API fails fast in Production unless E6_JWT_KEY is set in /etc/e6carspa/api.env — the signing key must never sit in this file.
